name: EuRoC MAV
title: The EuRoC micro aerial vehicle datasets

license.en: Consult the ETH Research Collection record; dataset licence was not independently verified in this audit.
license.zh: 以 ETH Research Collection 条目许可为准；本次未独立核验数据许可。

summary.en: Canonical stereo-inertial MAV benchmark with metric motion references; a perspective-camera baseline for wide-FoV VIO studies.
summary.zh: 经典双目惯性无人机基准，提供米制运动参考，可作为广视场 VIO 的透视相机对照。

en.Geometry: Monochrome stereo, 20 Hz; IMU, 200 Hz. Not a panoramic or fisheye release.
en.Ground-truth provenance: Vicon 6DoF pose or Leica laser-tracker 3D position, depending on sequence; structure scans are also available.
en.Calibration and time: Camera intrinsics, camera–IMU extrinsics and aligned references are supplied. Separate reference recording systems leave documented synchronization limits.
en.Evaluation: Use the supplied sensor/body transforms and timestamps; position-only laser measurements do not independently observe every orientation.
en.Download: Official hosting moved to ETH Research Collection.

zh.成像模型: 20 Hz 灰度双目与 200 Hz IMU；不是全景或鱼眼数据。
zh.真值来源: 不同序列采用 Vicon 六自由度位姿或 Leica 激光跟踪三维位置，并提供结构扫描。
zh.标定与时间: 提供相机内参、相机–IMU 外参和已对齐参考；独立参考采集系统仍有文档说明的同步限制。
zh.评测: 使用数据所定义的传感器/机体变换与时间戳；激光仪的纯位置测量不能独立观测所有姿态。
zh.下载: 官方文件已迁移至 ETH Research Collection。

en: No per-frame dense image-depth ground truth is assumed.
Aggressive motion can degrade the laser-tracker reference.
zh: 不将其视为逐帧稠密图像深度真值集。

name: TUM RGB-D
title: A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems

license.en: CC BY 4.0 data unless otherwise stated; accompanying code BSD-2-Clause.
license.zh: 除另有说明，数据为 CC BY 4.0；附带代码为 BSD-2-Clause。

summary.en: Real Kinect RGB-D sequences with independent motion capture, useful for metric RGB-D SLAM and reconstruction baselines.
summary.zh: 真实 Kinect RGB-D 序列与独立动作捕捉位姿，适合米制 RGB-D SLAM 和重建对照。

en.Inputs: 640×480 RGB and measured depth, nominally 30 Hz; timestamps are provided separately.
en.Depth convention: 16-bit PNG values divided by 5000 give metres; zero indicates missing depth. Released RGB/depth are registered.
en.Pose reference: Motion-capture trajectories at 100 Hz; pose format is timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw in the reference world.
en.Calibration: Use the per-camera parameters and dataset notes; do not apply a second distortion correction to already registered depth.
en.Evaluation: Associate timestamps and apply the published ATE/RPE tools; retain depth holes and masks.

zh.输入: 640×480 RGB 与实测深度，标称 30 Hz；各自提供时间戳。
zh.深度约定: 16 位 PNG 除以 5000 得到米，零值表示缺测；发布的 RGB/深度已经配准。
zh.位姿参考: 100 Hz 动作捕捉轨迹；格式为时间戳、平移 tx ty tz 和四元数 qx qy qz qw。
zh.标定: 使用各相机参数及数据说明；不要对已经配准的深度再次做畸变校正。
zh.评测: 先关联时间戳，再用官方 ATE/RPE 工具；保留深度空洞及有效掩码。

en: Measured Kinect depth is noisy and incomplete, not perfect dense geometry.
Kinect accelerometer data is not a full gyro–accelerometer IMU.
zh: Kinect 实测深度有噪声和缺测，并非完美稠密几何。
Kinect 加速度数据不是完整的陀螺仪–加速度计 IMU。

license.en: CC BY 4.0 data; accompanying code BSD-2-Clause.

summary.en: Hardware-synchronized 195° stereo fisheye and IMU with photometric calibration; full room trajectories but partial reference elsewhere.
summary.zh: 硬件同步的 195° 双目鱼眼与 IMU，附光度标定；房间序列有完整参考，其他序列通常只有起终段。

en.Inputs: 1024×1024 16-bit linear images at 20 Hz; IMU at 200 Hz. Downsampled exports are also provided.
en.Ground-truth coverage: Room sequences: full motion capture. Corridor, magistrale, outdoors and slides: start/end segments only.
en.Reference frame: Calibrated ground truth is in the IMU frame; corrected timestamps and IMU scaling are already applied.
en.Calibration: Geometric, camera–IMU, exposure/vignette and IMU-noise resources are supplied.
en.Evaluation: Evaluate only reference-covered intervals; endpoint drift is not full-route ATE.

zh.输入: 1024×1024、16 位线性图像，20 Hz；IMU 为 200 Hz，另提供降采样版本。
zh.真值覆盖: room 序列有完整动作捕捉；corridor、magistrale、outdoors、slides 仅起终段有真值。
zh.参考坐标系: 标定版本真值已转到 IMU 坐标系，并已校正时间戳与 IMU 比例。
zh.标定: 提供几何、相机–IMU、曝光/暗角和 IMU 噪声资料。
zh.评测: 仅在真值覆盖区间计算对应误差；端点漂移不等于全程 ATE。

en: No dense depth labels; this is a VIO/SLAM benchmark.
Do not apply raw-clock offsets again to calibrated exports.
zh: 没有稠密深度标签，主要用于 VIO/SLAM。

summary.en: Driving stereo/LiDAR odometry baseline with metric reference trajectories and an established subsequence-error protocol.
summary.zh: 经典车载双目/LiDAR 里程计基准，提供米制参考轨迹及成熟的分段误差评测协议。

en.Split: 22 stereo sequences: 00–10 expose reference trajectories; 11–21 withhold them for server evaluation.
en.Geometry: Perspective stereo and Velodyne scans. This entry is separate from KITTI depth prediction/completion.
en.Pose and scale: GPS/OXTS-based metric reference; use the official devkit coordinate and pose conventions.
en.Protocol: Translation/rotation drift over 100–800 m subsequences; report scale alignment explicitly for monocular estimates.
en.Access: Downloads require login; leaderboard submissions have publication and novelty policies.

zh.成像模型: 透视双目和 Velodyne 扫描；此条目与 KITTI 深度预测/补全分开。
zh.位姿与尺度: GPS/OXTS 米制参考；采用官方开发工具的坐标与位姿约定。
zh.协议: 在 100–800 米子轨迹上评估平移/旋转漂移；单目结果是否对齐尺度需明确报告。
zh.获取: 下载需要登录；榜单提交另有论文及创新性要求。

Use official training splits for local experiments when server submission criteria do not apply.
zh: 不是原生全景或鱼眼图像。

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; registration and intended-use declaration required.
license.zh: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0；需注册并说明用途。

summary.en: Urban mapping with front perspective stereo plus side 180° fisheye cameras; 360° coverage comes from a rig, not stitched ERP frames.
summary.zh: 前向透视双目加两侧 180° 鱼眼的城市建图数据；360° 覆盖来自相机组，不是拼接 ERP 图像。

en.Ground truth: Georegistered poses are optimized using SfM with GPS and LiDAR constraints, not raw OXTS alone.
en.Coordinates: poses.txt is IMU-to-world; cam0_to_world.txt is rectified camera-0-to-world. Some slowly moving frames lack entries.
en.Depth use: Laser scans and 3D geometry can be projected with the supplied models; this does not guarantee dense per-pixel depth.
en.Calibration: Perspective intrinsics/rectification, fisheye YAMLs and sensor extrinsics are provided.
en.Protocol: Use the localisation/mapping task split; avoid treating derived pose optimization as independent motion capture.

zh.真值: 地理配准位姿由 SfM 加 GPS/LiDAR 约束优化得到，并不等同于原始 OXTS。
zh.坐标约定: poses.txt 为 IMU 到世界；cam0_to_world.txt 为校正后相机 0 到世界；低速运动时部分帧无位姿条目。
zh.深度使用: 可利用官方相机模型投影扫描与三维几何，但不能据此假设每像素都有稠密深度。
zh.标定: 提供透视内参/校正、鱼眼 YAML 和传感器外参。
zh.协议: 按定位/建图任务的划分使用；优化位姿不能当作独立动作捕捉测量。

en: No native panoramic camera tag: the source release is multi-camera.

zh: 不标为原生全景：源数据发布形式是多相机。

name: TartanAir V2
title: TartanAir: A Dataset to Push the Limits of Visual SLAM
venue: V2 dataset / toolkit; original paper: IROS 2020

zh: 仿真米制深度／重采样径向距离

license.en: V2 dataset: CC BY 4.0; tartanairpy toolkit: MIT. Attribute the data and state modifications; the software licence does not replace the data licence.
license.zh: V2 数据为 CC BY 4.0，tartanairpy 工具为 MIT。使用数据须署名并注明修改；软件许可不能替代数据许可。

summary.en: Synthetic stereo, panoramic and fisheye data for depth and SLAM: synchronized cubefaces, resampled RGB/depth/semantics, metric poses and derived inertial/LiDAR signals.
summary.zh: 用于深度与 SLAM 的合成双目、全景及鱼眼数据：同步六面视图可重采样 RGB／深度／语义，并提供米制位姿及派生 IMU、LiDAR。

en.Version and year: 2020 and the linked paper refer to the original TartanAir publication, not a verified V2 release year. This record documents the current V2 dataset/toolkit; its separate release date was not established.
en.Raw cameras and baseline: Two simulated optical centres, 0.25 m apart; six 90° pinhole directions per centre cover a sphere. Each raw view is 640×640 at 10 Hz (f=320, principal point=(320,320)); the six directions do not create six stereo baselines.
en.Panorama and fisheye: Official download/API names include lcam/rcam_fish and lcam/rcam_equirect for RGB, depth and semantics. These are resampled pinhole data, not independently captured fisheye/ERP sensors. Inspect actual availability for the chosen environment and trajectory.
en.Custom camera models: ta.customize() supports pinhole, DoubleSphere, LinearSphere and Equirectangular at the reviewed tartanairpy commit 158a684; save raw_side, R_raw_new and model parameters. A custom 195° DoubleSphere example is not the default downloaded fisheye specification.
en.Depth format and meaning: Decode four-channel PNG bytes as little-endian float32 without integer scaling. Raw pinhole depth is Z; reviewed reader.read_dist() converts it to ray distance before ta.customize() resampling. That custom output is range, including custom pinhole output; do not apply the raw-Z conversion twice to ERP/fisheye files. Pin precomputed archives to their own generation convention.
en.Valid depth: Exclude invalid/nonpositive or nonfinite values, invalid camera rays and far-sky returns; the official modality documentation warns that sky depths can be very large. Publish the task-specific maximum range and mask instead of assuming a universal valid cutoff.
en.Poses and calibration: Pose rows are tx ty tz qx qy qz qw, describing camera-to-world position/orientation with NED conventions (forward, right, down). Keep metric translation, per-view rotations and stereo extrinsics. Customizer rotates quaternion orientation when R_raw_new changes; transformed views are not new physical trajectories.
en.Timing and derived sensors: Raw RGB/depth are aligned and synchronized. IMU is synthesized by differentiating interpolated poses, with configurable rate/noise; LiDAR is sampled from depth. Events use separately recollected 1000 Hz RGB and may differ in dynamic scenes. These are simulated signals, not measured sensor ground truth.
en.Flow and access: Use pip install tartanair and ta.download() to select environments, easy/hard trajectories, cameras and modalities. Current documentation moves flow labels to local generation; do not infer every modality is precomputed from an older all-modality example.
en.Evaluation and split: Report the exact environments, trajectories, camera sampler and depth masks. Keep all resampled views of one trajectory in the same split; easy/hard folders alone are not an independent scene split. For ATE/RPE, state alignment and whether scale correction was enabled; synthetic accuracy does not establish real-camera robustness.

zh.版本与年份: 2020 与论文链接对应原始 TartanAir 论文，不能视为已核实的 V2 发布年份。本条整理当前 V2 数据与工具，尚未确证其单独发布日期。
zh.原始相机与基线: 两个相距 0.25 m 的仿真光心，每个光心有六个朝向的 90° 透视图以覆盖球面。原图为 640×640、10 Hz，焦距 320、主点 (320,320)；六个朝向不是六组独立双目基线。
zh.全景与鱼眼: 官方下载/API 为 RGB、深度和语义列出 lcam/rcam_fish 与 lcam/rcam_equirect。它们由透视数据重采样，不是独立采集的鱼眼／ERP 传感器；应按目标环境和轨迹核对实际可用项。
zh.自定义相机模型: 核验的 tartanairpy 提交 158a684 中，ta.customize() 支持 pinhole、DoubleSphere、LinearSphere 与 Equirectangular；需保存 raw_side、R_raw_new 和模型参数。示例的 195° DoubleSphere 不能当作默认下载鱼眼的规格。
zh.深度格式与语义: 四通道 PNG 的字节应按小端 float32 解码，不作整数缩放。原始透视深度为 Z；核验的 reader.read_dist() 先转为射线距离，再由 ta.customize() 重采样。因此该入口的自定义输出为 range，连自定义透视输出也如此；ERP／鱼眼文件不能重复做原始 Z 转换。预计算压缩包仍须核对其生成约定。
zh.深度有效性: 排除非正数、非有限值、模型无效射线与远处天空；官方说明天空可能返回极大深度。应记录任务使用的距离上限和掩码，不假设统一有效阈值。
zh.位姿与标定: 位姿每行为 tx ty tz qx qy qz qw，表示相机到世界的位置／朝向，采用 NED 约定（前、右、下）。保留米制平移、逐视图旋转与双目外参。改变 R_raw_new 后 customizer 会同步旋转四元数；重采样视图不是新增物理轨迹。
zh.时序与派生传感器: 原始 RGB／深度对齐且同步。IMU 对插值位姿求导合成，频率和噪声可配；LiDAR 由深度采样。事件以另行重采的 1000 Hz RGB 生成，在动态场景可能与其他模态不一致。这些均为仿真信号，不能表述成实测传感器真值。
zh.光流与获取: 通过 pip install tartanair 与 ta.download() 选择环境、easy/hard 轨迹、相机和模态。当前文档将光流转为本地生成，不能从旧的全模态示例推断都可直接下载。
zh.评测与划分: 注明具体环境、轨迹、相机采样器与深度掩码；同一轨迹的重采样视图必须归入同一划分，easy/hard 目录本身不是独立场景划分。ATE/RPE 需注明对齐与是否校正尺度；仿真精度不等于对真实相机的鲁棒性。

en: The linked IROS 2020 paper documents the original dataset. Version-specific claims above are checked against the V2 documentation and toolkit.
zh: 链接的 IROS 2020 论文描述原始数据集；上述 V2 特性以当前 V2 文档和工具实现为证据。

name: Hilti SLAM 2021
title: The Hilti SLAM Challenge Dataset

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 dataset and benchmark.
license.zh: 数据与基准采用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0。

summary.en: Wide-FoV multicamera, dual-LiDAR and inertial construction benchmark; sparse surveyed positions must be distinguished from full pose trajectories.
summary.zh: 广视场多相机、双 LiDAR 与惯性的施工环境基准；需区分稀疏测量位置和完整位姿轨迹。

en.Geometry: Five Alphasense cameras cover approximately 270° in total; a physical stereo pair is included. Not a stitched ERP sensor.
en.Ground truth: Most sequences: stationary total-station 3DoF positions. Lab/arena sequences: OptiTrack 6DoF.

en.Synchronization: FPGA and PTP synchronization; sensor TF tree, calibration and noise resources are supplied.

zh.成像模型: 五个 Alphasense 相机总覆盖约 270°，包含真实双目；不是拼接 ERP 传感器。
zh.真值: 大多数序列为全站仪在静止时测量的三自由度位置；实验室/测试场序列提供 OptiTrack 六自由度真值。
zh.精度与坐标系: 官方给出参考精度优于 5 毫米；文件名标明参考坐标系，例如棱镜。
zh.同步: 采用 FPGA 和 PTP，同步资料、TF 树、标定及噪声资源随数据提供。
zh.评测: 在测量时刻比较正确变换后的参考点；稀疏控制点不能用于全程稠密轨迹 ATE。

en: Year denotes the 2021 challenge; the journal paper is RA-L 2022.
LiDAR scans are measurements, not complete dense image-depth labels.
zh: 年份对应 2021 挑战；期刊论文发表于 RA-L 2022。

name: Hilti-Oxford 2022
title: Hilti-Oxford Dataset: A Millimeter-Accurate Benchmark for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 dataset and benchmark.
license.zh: 数据与基准采用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0。

summary.en: Five synchronized fisheye cameras, Hesai LiDAR and IMU in construction sites and the Sheldonian Theatre; surveyed control points target millimetre accuracy.
summary.zh: 五个同步鱼眼相机、Hesai LiDAR 与 IMU，覆盖施工现场和谢尔登剧院，以毫米级测量控制点评估。

en.Inputs: Five 40 Hz global-shutter fisheye streams, 400 Hz IMU and 10 Hz Hesai LiDAR.
en.Ground truth: Challenge data uses sparse surveyed 3DoF positions; selected additional sequences provide denser 6DoF references.
en.Reference frame: All released ground-truth data is expressed in the IMU frame.
en.Calibration: Kalibr-like equidistant camera models, camera–IMU calibration recordings, noise data and rig CAD are provided.
en.Protocol: Respect the challenge control-point evaluation; do not assume every frame has millimetre-accurate orientation.

zh.输入: 五路 40 Hz 全局快门鱼眼、400 Hz IMU 与 10 Hz Hesai LiDAR。
zh.真值: 挑战序列采用稀疏测量三维位置；部分附加序列另有更密的六自由度参考。
zh.参考坐标系: 发布的真值统一位于 IMU 坐标系。
zh.标定: 提供类似 Kalibr 的等距畸变参数、相机–IMU 标定记录、噪声资料和机架 CAD。
zh.协议: 采用挑战控制点评测；不能假设每帧都有毫米级姿态。

en: 2022 denotes challenge release; the journal citation is RA-L 2023.
Five fisheye views are a camera rig, not a single ERP panorama.
zh: 2022 为挑战发布年份，期刊引用为 RA-L 2023。
五路鱼眼是相机组，不是单幅 ERP 全景。

name: Hilti–Trimble–Oxford 2026 · Indoor
title: Hilti-Trimble-Oxford Dataset: 360 Visual-Inertial Benchmark with Floor Plan Priors for SLAM and Localization

license.en: Dataset: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, as declared by the official Hugging Face card. Open access does not remove its non-commercial and share-alike conditions.
license.zh: 数据集采用官方 Hugging Face 卡片声明的 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0；开放下载仍须遵守非商业使用和相同方式共享等条件。

summary.en: Thirty indoor construction runs with dual approximately 200° fisheyes, IMU, floor-plan priors and LiDAR-inertial reference poses; ERP is derived using official stitching tools, not the native release.
summary.zh: 30 条室内施工楼层序列，提供双约 200° 鱼眼、IMU、平面图先验及 LiDAR 惯性参考位姿；ERP 需用官方工具派生，原始发布为双鱼眼。

en.Indoor scope: The official sequence guide lists 30 floor-labelled runs from May to December 2025: floors 1–7, EG, UG1 and UG2. Download by floor/date/run; this entry covers those indoor construction sequences.
en.Released sensor streams: Insta360 ONE RS 1-Inch 360 Edition: two 1472×1440 RGB fisheye streams at 30 Hz and a six-axis IMU at 1000 Hz. Lenses cover approximately 200° each. The cameras use rolling shutters; the supplied configuration gives a 31.0512 ms frame readout.
en.Panoramic representation: Only raw front/back fisheyes are released. The official image_stitching.py tool derives ERP, with a Stella-VSLAM example. Distinct optical centres and nonzero baseline introduce parallax; the large-sphere stitching assumption is not an exact central panorama without depth.
en.Calibration: Kalibr camera–IMU extrinsics, per-camera time offsets, IMU configuration, calibration bags and AprilGrid files are available. EUCM is calibrated directly; the provided pinhole-equidistant intrinsics are fitted to EUCM. Use the matching camera model and retain the original image orientation for rolling-shutter correction.
en.Time synchronization: All runs retain a +10000 s timestamp shift. Reference LiDAR and its IMU use hardware PPS; the independent camera system is aligned through gyro-norm correlation and nonlinear refinement of time offset, linear clock scale and gyro biases. This is not common hardware synchronization of every sensor.
en.Reference pose provenance: Hesai XT32M2X LiDAR-inertial SLAM, rigidly attached to the camera, yields estimated references transformed into cam0 by extrinsics and clock alignment. Manuscript v2 explicitly states that independent survey measurements were not possible here. Its cited 3.94 cm / 0.7 cm accuracies concern earlier challenges with independently surveyed truth, not measured accuracy of these 30 reference trajectories. Raw reference LiDAR is absent from the released ROS 2 bags.
en.Pose format and valid interval: Reference poses express cam0 in the map frame (cam0→map). TUM text uses timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw, with translations in metres. Approximately the first 5 seconds lack LiDAR reference coverage; the initial localization pose is near t=10005 s.
en.Floor-plan priors: PNG, DXF and binary masks with/without windows describe the planned completed building, which can differ from the changing as-built scene. Manuscript v2 states PNGs are manually labelled at 1 px = 1 cm, with 1–3 px annotation uncertainty after scaling; DXFs are not registered to the PNGs. The repository cautions that the plans are not officially registered. Use its map convention and initial poses. floor_UG2_2025-12-02_run_1 has no floor plan and remains SLAM-only. Section V-D separately describes manual initialization plus ICP alignment of reference LiDAR geometry to floor plans; that is distinct from DXF-to-PNG registration.
en.Evaluation protocol: All 30 references are now public. The original challenge scored 25 SLAM runs and 24 localization runs, excluding five early-release runs and additionally UG2 for localization. It requires at least 99% trajectory coverage and preserves metric scale; localization scoring ignores z.
en.Download and publication: The official data endpoint was previously checked on 2026-10-19 as public and non-gated; fetch complete rosbag folders including rosbag.db3 and metadata.yaml. ArXiv v2 was posted 2026-10-21 and its accepted-manuscript front matter records IEEE RA-L acceptance on 2026-10-11. Final publisher DOI, volume and pages remain unverified; the paper revision is not a new dataset release.
en.Reference and map uncertainty: The paper reports about 2 cm average LiDAR-to-floorplan discrepancy caused by as-built/as-planned differences. This is not a measured trajectory-error bound. Manuscript v2 cautions against overinterpreting method differences of a few centimetres.
en.Sequence characterization: Manuscript v2 corrects coverage to ten floors (eight above-ground levels plus two underground parking levels) and characterizes five difficulty factors: clutter, low light, dynamic initialization, aggressive motion and poor texture. This clarification does not add sequences to the existing 30-run release.

zh.室内范围: 官方序列指南列有 30 条楼层序列，采集于 2025 年 5–12 月，覆盖 1–7 层、EG、UG1 和 UG2；按楼层/日期/run 选择下载。本条整理这些室内施工序列。
zh.实际传感器输入: Insta360 ONE RS 1-Inch 360 Edition：两路 30 Hz、1472×1440 RGB 鱼眼，以及 1000 Hz 六轴 IMU；每个镜头约 200°。相机为卷帘快门，随附配置给出的整帧读出时间为 31.0512 ms。
zh.全景表示: 原始数据仅发布前后双鱼眼；官方 image_stitching.py 可生成 ERP，并给出 Stella-VSLAM 示例。两个镜头光心不同且存在非零基线，拼接会有视差；大半径球面假设不等同于有深度支持的精确中心全景。
zh.标定: 提供 Kalibr 相机–IMU 外参、各相机时间偏移、IMU 配置、标定 bag 和 AprilGrid。EUCM 直接标定，pinhole-equidistant 内参由 EUCM 拟合。须使用匹配的相机模型，并为卷帘校正保留原始图像方向。
zh.时间同步: 各 run 保留 +10000 s 的时间戳平移。参考 LiDAR 与其 IMU 通过 PPS 硬件同步；独立运行的相机系统先用陀螺仪模长相关对齐，再联合优化时间偏移、线性时钟尺度和陀螺仪偏置，不能理解为全部传感器共用硬同步。
zh.参考位姿来源: 与相机刚性连接的 Hesai XT32M2X LiDAR 惯性 SLAM 生成参考估计，再经外参和时钟对齐变换到 cam0。v2 明确说明本次无法进行独立测量；所引 3.94 cm／0.7 cm 精度来自有独立测量真值的过往挑战，不是这 30 条参考轨迹的实测误差。发布的 ROS 2 bag 不含参考 LiDAR。
zh.位姿格式与有效区间: 参考轨迹为 cam0 在 map 中的位姿（cam0→map）；TUM 文本依次为 timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw，平移单位为米。约前 5 秒没有 LiDAR 参考覆盖；初始平面图定位位姿在 t=10005 s 附近。
zh.平面图先验: PNG、DXF 及带窗／不带窗二值掩码对应完工规划，可能与施工实景不同。v2 说明 PNG 由人工标注，以 1 px＝1 cm 缩放后有 1–3 px 标注不确定性；DXF 未与 PNG 配准。仓库仍提示平面图未经过官方配准，应采用其 map 坐标约定与初始位姿。floor_UG2_2025-12-02_run_1 无平面图，仅参加 SLAM。 第 V-D 节另述参考 LiDAR 几何经人工初始化与 ICP 对齐到平面图，这与 DXF 到 PNG 配准是不同关系。
zh.评测协议: 目前 30 条参考轨迹均已公开。原挑战对 25 条 SLAM、24 条定位序列计分：排除 5 条早期公开序列，定位另排除 UG2。至少要求 99% 轨迹覆盖，不优化尺度；定位分数忽略 z。
zh.下载与发表: 官方数据入口此前于 2026-10-19 核验为公开、非 gated；应下载含 rosbag.db3 与 metadata.yaml 的完整目录。arXiv v2 于 2026-10-21 发布，录用稿首页记录 IEEE RA-L 于 2026-10-11 接收。出版社正式 DOI、卷期页码仍待核实；论文修订不等于新数据集发布。
zh.参考与地图不确定性: 论文报告 LiDAR 与平面图平均约 2 cm 的实建／规划差异；这不是轨迹误差实测界限。v2 提醒不要过度解读方法之间几厘米的差别。
zh.序列难度说明: v2 将覆盖范围更正为十层（八个地上楼层及两个地下停车层），并列五类难度：杂乱／遮挡、弱光、动态初始化、剧烈运动与弱纹理。这是说明修订，不是向原 30 条发布中新增序列。

zh.精度: 官方区分静态亚毫米级位置精度与动态数毫米误差。
zh.标定与时间: 说明 Ocam-Toolbox 内参、多相机/激光/刚体外参及逐图像/扫描时间戳。
zh.任务: 室内外静态/动态序列的 SLAM 轨迹 ATE/RPE 和建图；激光回波不等于完整图像深度真值。

en: The outdoor large-loop sequence leaves the tracking volume; its full path does not have continuous mocap.
Full archives were not downloaded; download entry points are linked from the official project.

name: Oxford Spires
title: The Oxford Spires Dataset: Benchmarking Large-Scale LiDAR-Visual Localisation, Reconstruction and Radiance Field Methods

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; intended for non-commercial academic use.
license.zh: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，面向非商业学术用途。

summary.en: Three colour fisheye views and survey maps for large-scale localisation/reconstruction; official tools can derive sparse image depth from LiDAR.
summary.zh: 三路彩色鱼眼与测量地图构成的大尺度定位/重建基准，官方工具可由 LiDAR 生成图像稀疏深度。

en.Inputs: Three global-shutter colour fisheyes at 20 Hz, Hesai QT64 LiDAR at 10 Hz and camera-synchronized IMU at 400 Hz.
en.Independent map: Leica RTC360 TLS provides millimetre-accurate reference geometry.
en.Pose reference: Core sequences have centimetre-accurate LiDAR poses registered to the TLS map; poses give base-to-world transforms.
en.Derived depth: Official script projects undistorted LiDAR clouds into cameras. These are scan-derived sparse depths, not dense independent depth labels.
en.Data hygiene: Calibration and raw recordings are supplied. Keep VILENS-SLAM/COLMAP outputs separate from survey GT.

zh.输入: 三路 20 Hz 全局快门彩色鱼眼、10 Hz Hesai QT64 LiDAR，以及与相机同步的 400 Hz IMU。
zh.独立地图: Leica RTC360 地面激光扫描提供毫米级参考几何。
zh.位姿参考: 核心序列提供配准到测量地图的厘米级 LiDAR 位姿，为基座到世界变换。
zh.推导深度: 官方脚本将去畸变 LiDAR 点云投到相机，所得为扫描推导的稀疏深度，并非稠密独立深度标签。
zh.数据区分: 提供标定与原始记录；VILENS-SLAM/COLMAP 输出需与测量真值分开。

en: Not all sequences have the core localisation ground-truth trajectory.
TLS map accuracy and trajectory-registration accuracy are different quantities.
2025 denotes public release/acceptance; the preprint first appeared in 2024.
zh: 并非所有序列都具有核心定位基准的真值轨迹。
地面扫描地图精度与轨迹配准精度是不同指标。
2025 对应公开发布/接收年份；预印本首发于 2024 年。

name: 360DVO Dataset
title: 360DVO: Deep Visual Odometry for Monocular 360-Degree Camera — real-world benchmark

zh: 不同来源的 360° RGB 视频

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as declared by the official Hugging Face dataset card; original video provenance remains documented in the paper.
license.zh: 官方 Hugging Face 数据卡声明 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；原始视频来源仍需参考论文。

summary.en: Real panoramic video benchmark with 20 Easy/Hard sequences and Agisoft Metashape trajectory references; these are SfM pseudo ground truth, not independent tracking measurements.
summary.zh: 包含 20 段 Easy/Hard 真实全景视频及 Agisoft Metashape 参考轨迹；位姿属于 SfM 伪真值，不是独立跟踪测量。

en.Projection and timing: ERP RGB frames are standardized to 3840×1920 at 10 FPS. The paper also evaluates derived 90-degree, 640×640 perspective views; these are crops/reprojections, not extra physical cameras.
en.Capture provenance: Three sequences come from 360VOTS, fifteen from internet videos, and two from Hong Kong tram recordings. A common physical camera/IMU rig and shared hardware calibration are not established.
en.Pose reference: Agisoft Metashape SfM produces the pseudo-reference trajectories. No independent motion capture, RTK, or dense measured depth is claimed.
en.Evaluation and scale: Easy and Hard each contain ten sequences. The paper uses Sim(3) Umeyama alignment, reports ATE in meters and RPE in m/frame and deg/frame, and evaluates overlapping trajectory segments. Independent absolute metric calibration of each real sequence is not established.
en.Access and version: The official HF repository is public and ungated, with Sequences/ and twenty GroundTruth/ files listed. Full image payloads were not downloaded. HF createdAt is 2026-01-04; this is an older omission, not an October release.

zh.投影与时间: ERP RGB 统一为 3840×1920、10 FPS。论文另评估 90°、640×640 的派生透视视图；它们是裁剪/重投影，不是额外真实相机。
zh.采集来源: 3 段来自 360VOTS，15 段来自网络视频，2 段为香港电车实录；未建立共同的相机/IMU 机架或统一硬件标定。
zh.位姿参考: 参考轨迹由 Agisoft Metashape SfM 产生；不宣称独立动作捕捉、RTK 或稠密实测深度。
zh.评测与尺度: Easy/Hard 各 10 段。论文采用 Sim(3) Umeyama 对齐，ATE 用米、平移/旋转 RPE 用米/帧和度/帧，仅评估轨迹重叠段。各真实序列的独立绝对公制标定未获证实。
zh.获取与版本: 官方 HF 仓库公开、无门控，列有 Sequences/ 及 20 个 GroundTruth/ 文件；未下载完整图像。HF 创建于 2026-01-04，本轮属于补漏，不能称为十月新发布。

en: HF's automatic train split and viewer row count are storage/viewer artifacts, not the paper's Easy/Hard evaluation protocol.
No dense depth GT is inferred from the VO method's internal patch depths; pose serialization, timestamps and scale must be checked before using a new loader.
zh: HF 自动生成的 train 划分和预览行数是存储/预览产物，不等于论文的 Easy/Hard 评测协议。
不根据 VO 方法内部的图像块深度推断稠密深度真值；使用新加载器前需核对位姿文件格式、时间戳和尺度。

name: ODGS-SLAM Dataset
title: ODGS-SLAM Dataset: synthetic and real omnidirectional motion sequences

zh: 真实全景的立体估计深度

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, explicitly recorded in the official University of Innsbruck repository API metadata.
license.zh: 因斯布鲁克大学官方数据仓库 API 元数据明确声明 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。

summary.en: Public synthetic indoor/outdoor and real indoor SLAM sequences compare ERP, six-fisheye rigs and perspective inputs; rendered depths, mocap poses and estimated real depths have distinct provenance.
summary.zh: 公开的合成室内/室外与真实室内 SLAM 序列，对比 ERP、六鱼眼机架及透视输入；需区分渲染深度、动作捕捉位姿和真实图像的估计深度。

en.Subsets and provenance: Indoor room and outdoor urban subsets are fully synthetic Blender Cycles renders, not photogrammetric real scans. The real subset records a myAGV robot indoors; five Insta360 Pro and eight X4 sequences are documented.
en.Physical camera outputs: Real Pro data includes six 1440×1920 fisheye streams at 30 FPS and 1920×960 stitched ERP. X4 provides 3840×1920 stitched ERP at 60 FPS, without separate physical lens images in this release.
en.Depth provenance: Synthetic ERP/pinhole EXR depths are rendered; real Pro panorama EXR depths come from sphere-sweeping stereo and are estimates. The real X4 listing contains RGB, poses and robot masks, not depth. Depth encoding units and range-versus-Z are not settled by the inspected READMEs.
en.Pose and synchronization: Real OptiTrack tracks three markers with the reference origin at the camera mount; video alignment is manual. Apply the documented mount-specific Y rotation. Synthetic poses use Blender coordinates; both versions store XYZ Euler angles in radians. Translation units and a synchronization error bound are not specified in the inspected READMEs.
en.Calibration and protocols: MC-Calib YAML provides the Pro multicamera calibration. Synthetic views simulate that rig and also offer a 113-degree perspective camera. Choose the documented subset/sequence: some retracing data has only Camera_0; no universal train/validation/test split is asserted.
en.Access and version: University archive DOI 10.48323/z6f6r-sjc65, v1.0.0, published 2026-04-17. Three ZIPs and their separate small READMEs are publicly listed; only READMEs/API metadata were read. This is an older omission, not a new October dataset.

zh.子集与来源: 室内房间及室外城市子集均由 Blender Cycles 完全合成，并非真实扫描后摄影测量的场景；真实子集在室内记录 myAGV，列有 5 段 Pro 和 8 段 X4 序列。
zh.真实相机输出: Pro 包含 6 路 1440×1920、30 FPS 鱼眼及 1920×960 拼接 ERP；X4 提供 3840×1920、60 FPS 拼接 ERP，本发布不含独立镜头图像。
zh.深度来源: 合成 ERP/透视 EXR 深度来自渲染；真实 Pro 全景 EXR 深度由球面扫描立体算法估计。真实 X4 列表包含 RGB、位姿和机器人掩码，不含深度。所读 README 未确定深度编码单位及径向距离/Z 定义。
zh.位姿与同步: 真实 OptiTrack 跟踪三个标记点，参考原点为相机安装位置；视频按运动模式手工对时，并需应用各安装配置的 Y 轴补偿旋转。合成位姿采用 Blender 坐标；两者 XYZ 欧拉角均为弧度。所读 README 未说明平移单位或同步误差界限。
zh.标定与协议: MC-Calib YAML 提供 Pro 多相机标定；合成视图模拟该机架，另含 113° 透视相机。按明确子集/序列选择数据；部分折返数据仅含 Camera_0，不宣称统一训练/验证/测试划分。
zh.获取与版本: 大学仓库 DOI 为 10.48323/z6f6r-sjc65，v1.0.0 发布于 2026-04-17。公开列出 3 个 ZIP 和各自小型 README；仅阅读说明/API，未下载完整数据。本轮属于旧遗漏补充。

en: Do not score the real stereo-estimated depth as an independent measured depth ground truth.
Synthetic camera-to-world uses Blender +Z up and optical axis −Z; real data uses world +Y up plus mount offsets. A single unchanged pose parser is unsafe across subsets.
A public archive listing establishes an access route, not a completed integrity or full-download test.
zh: 不能把真实序列的立体估计深度当作独立实测深度真值。
合成相机到世界采用 Blender 的 +Z 向上、光轴 −Z；真实数据世界 +Y 向上且有安装旋转。不同子集不能未经转换共用位姿解析器。
公开归档列表证明存在获取入口，不代表已完成全量下载和完整性校验。

name: PanoCARLA-Static
title: PanoCARLA-Static: static-scene panoramic RGB-D video with moving virtual cameras

zh: CARLA 0.9.16 虚拟 RGB/深度/语义相机
仿真相机位置与偏航角

license.en: CC BY 4.0 for the dataset, stated in the official card. Cite PVDepth; the collection repository's MIT code licence is separate.
license.zh: 官方数据卡声明数据为 CC BY 4.0；使用时引用 PVDepth，采集仓库的 MIT 代码许可单独适用。

summary.en: October 2026 HF release of static-scene CARLA panoramas with moving cameras, radial metric depth and simulator poses; shared route names do not make it pose-matched to dynamic PanoCARLA.
summary.zh: 2026 年 10 月发布到 HF 的 CARLA 静态场景全景序列，含移动相机、径向公制深度和仿真位姿；同名路线并不与动态 PanoCARLA 逐帧同位姿。

en.Release and access: Official HF API records creation on 2026-10-07 and update on 2026-10-08, with private=false and gated=false at this check. These dates describe this data repository, not the first publication date of the ICML 2026 PVDepth paper. Large data files were not downloaded.
en.Coverage and capture: The card lists 127,334 frames, 127 clips, 67 routes and eight towns at 20 FPS. Vehicles/pedestrians are removed while the camera moves with varying height. Six synchronized virtual views produce ERP; they are not a physical stereo rig or measured baseline.
en.Depth and validity: HDF5 depth is float16 [T,1200,2400,1] radial distance in meters. Capture code decodes CARLA depth with a 1000-meter scale; stitching converts optical-axis depth to ray distance. Check finite/positive validity and sky/far-plane masking for the selected evaluation; the 1000-meter source scale is not an ERP valid-depth cutoff.
en.Pose and coordinates: Float32 poses store x,y,z in CARLA world meters and yaw in degrees; pitch and roll are fixed at zero and omitted. Use each release's supplied poses, not a newly generated path or a dynamic-release trajectory.
en.Formats and indexing: RGB is uint8 [T,1200,2400,3]; segmentation uses uint8 CARLA IDs. setting_static.json maps frame IDs to HDF5 paths/indices. Collision/gap filtering creates clip boundaries; preview videos include excluded frames and do not share HDF5 indexing.
en.Evaluation and relation: Static and dynamic variants reuse overall routes but regenerate camera-height motion, so they are not pixel/pose-aligned pairs. Preserve town/route identity when splitting data; the card does not define a separate static train/validation/test benchmark.

zh.发布与获取: 官方 HF API 记录仓库于 2026-10-07 创建、10-08 更新，本次核验 private=false、gated=false。这是该数据仓库的日期，不是 ICML 2026 PVDepth 论文首发日期；未下载完整大文件。
zh.覆盖与采集: 数据卡列出 127334 帧、127 个片段、67 条路线、8 个城镇，20 FPS。移除车辆和行人，相机仍移动且高度变化；6 个同步虚拟视图生成 ERP，不是真实立体机架或实测基线。
zh.深度与有效性: HDF5 深度为 float16 [T,1200,2400,1]、米制径向距离。采集代码以 1000 米缩放解码 CARLA 深度，拼接时将光轴深度转为射线距离。按选定评测检查有限/正值、天空和远平面掩码；1000 米源缩放不能直接当作 ERP 有效深度上限。
zh.位姿与坐标: float32 位姿存储 CARLA 世界坐标的米制 x,y,z 和角度制 yaw；pitch、roll 固定为零而省略。几何计算应使用本版本位姿，不能借用新生成路线或动态版轨迹。
zh.格式与索引: RGB 为 uint8 [T,1200,2400,3]，语义为 uint8 CARLA 类别。setting_static.json 将源帧号映射到 HDF5 路径/索引；碰撞和帧号空隙决定片段边界，预览视频包含被剔除帧，不可与 HDF5 索引混用。
zh.评测与关联: 静态/动态版复用大致路线，但重新随机生成相机高度，因此不是逐像素、逐位姿对齐的数据对。划分应保留城镇/路线身份；数据卡未定义单独的静态版训练/验证/测试基准。

en: This is synthetic annotation, not measured physical depth or independently tracked real poses; yaw-only orientation limits motion diversity.
The original dynamic PanoCARLA repository is currently gated; access policies must be checked separately for each release.
HF viewer failure does not establish missing downloadable files; access=open is based on current public ungated repository metadata.
zh: 标注由仿真生成，并非物理深度测量或真实独立跟踪位姿；仅偏航角变化限制了运动多样性。
原始动态 PanoCARLA 当前有访问门控，不能把其政策套用到静态版；各发布需分别核对。
HF 预览器失败不代表文件无法下载；公开获取状态以当前无门控仓库元数据为据。

name: MILD / MILD-Sim
title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
aliases: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching

zh: 实际执行的机器人 TCP 参考轨迹

license.en: A dataset reuse license is not specified on the public project page or in the paper. Dataset, code and evaluation-manifest release is announced for acceptance; the paper's arXiv license does not establish a dataset license.
license.zh: 公开项目页与论文尚未明确数据集再利用许可。数据、代码与评测清单计划于论文录用后发布；论文的 arXiv 许可不能视为数据集许可。

summary.en: Announced close-range manipulation-localization benchmark: 86 real recordings with Insta360 X5 and Insight9, executed robot TCP references, and an Isaac Sim companion subset. Full data release is pending acceptance.
summary.zh: 面向近距离操作定位的已公布基准：包含 Insta360 X5 与 Insight9 的 86 段真实录制、实际执行的机器人 TCP 参考轨迹，以及 Isaac Sim 仿真子集；完整数据待论文录用后发布。

en.Scope and coverage: Real-world subset: 86 sensor recordings, comprising 67 Insta360 X5 and 19 Insight9 recordings across 15 repeated tabletop tasks on an AGIbot G2. The paper also lists nine MILD-Sim task entries; these are not nine additional real sensor recordings.
en.Imaging and inputs: X5 provides dual-fisheye observations and inertial measurements; Insight9 is described as a stereo/RGB-D sensing route. MILD-Sim uses Isaac Sim, with simulated fisheye stereo and RGB views shown on the project page. A raw ERP panorama release, exact lens FoV, resolutions and sampling rates are not established by the public release description.
en.Reference provenance: Each real execution has its own end-effector/TCP reference derived from logged robot kinematics and encoder feedback. It is not an external motion-capture reference or an AprilTag-surveyed global trajectory; residual robot-state, extrinsic-calibration and timing uncertainty remains.
en.Calibration and synchronization: The paper describes calibration assets for converting camera or visual-inertial estimates to the robot TCP frame. A downloadable manifest of sensor transforms, clock alignment and synchronization specifications is not yet available. Project comparison clips align separate recordings by normalized reference-trajectory progress, which does not establish hardware synchronization between devices.
en.Scenes and evaluation: Plain, textured/tablecloth, ArUco and AprilTag workspaces isolate feature scarcity, occlusion and marker-layout effects. Known marker IDs and sizes do not imply pre-surveyed marker poses. Evaluate SE(3)-aligned TCP-relative APE together with time completion and continuity, using each recording's executed reference rather than a shared command trajectory.
en.Simulation and depth: MILD-Sim supplies controlled robot/object/trajectory states and manipulation replay studies. Public descriptions do not establish a downloadable dense image-depth ground-truth release, depth convention, validity masks or a depth-estimation split; RGB-D hardware naming alone does not establish those annotations.
en.Release and splits: As checked on 2026-10-19, the paper and project page announce code, datasets and evaluation manifests upon acceptance. A complete public data-download endpoint, official train/validation/test split and dataset license are not confirmed. The restricted trajectory-upload pilot is an evaluation interface rather than a dataset download.

zh.范围与规模: 真实子集由 AGIbot G2 执行 15 项重复桌面任务，录制 86 段传感器序列，其中 Insta360 X5 为 67 段、Insight9 为 19 段。论文另列 9 项 MILD-Sim 任务条目，不应将其理解为另外 9 段真实传感器录制。
zh.成像与输入: X5 提供双鱼眼观测和惯性测量；Insight9 被描述为双目/RGB-D 感知路线。MILD-Sim 使用 Isaac Sim，项目页展示仿真鱼眼双目和 RGB 视图。公开发布说明尚未确认原始 ERP 全景数据、准确单镜头视场角、分辨率与采样率。
zh.参考轨迹来源: 每次真实执行均有独立的末端执行器/TCP 参考，由机器人运动学日志与编码器反馈得到。它不是外部动作捕捉真值，也不是经全局测量的 AprilTag 轨迹；仍包含机器人状态、外参标定与同步的残余不确定性。
zh.标定与同步: 论文描述了将相机或视觉惯性估计转换到机器人 TCP 坐标系的标定资产。传感器变换、时钟对齐和同步规格的可下载清单尚未公开。项目页的跨设备对比片段按参考轨迹的归一化进度对齐，不能据此推断设备之间硬件同步。
zh.场景与评测: 无标记、纹理桌布、ArUco 与 AprilTag 工作区用于区分特征稀缺、遮挡和标记布局影响。已知标记 ID 与尺寸不代表已测量标记全局位姿。以各次执行自己的参考轨迹进行 SE(3) 对齐的 TCP 相对 APE 评测，并同时考察时间完成率与连续性，而不是共用指令轨迹。
zh.仿真与深度: MILD-Sim 提供可观测的机器人、物体与轨迹状态及操作回放研究。公开说明尚未确认可下载的稠密图像深度真值、深度定义、有效掩码或深度估计划分；不能仅凭 RGB-D 硬件名称推断这些标注已发布。
zh.发布与划分: 截至 2026-10-19，论文和项目页仍声明代码、数据集与评测清单于录用后发布。完整公开下载入口、官方训练/验证/测试划分及数据许可尚未确认。受限轨迹上传试点是评测接口，不是数据集下载入口。

en: Relevant to fisheye/wide-FoV visual-inertial localization for UMI-style manipulation; full-sphere ERP support is not inferred from the Insta360 product name.
Public video excerpts and upload-duration limits do not specify the complete dataset's sequence durations.
zh: 适用于 UMI 式操作的鱼眼/广视场视觉惯性定位研究；不从 Insta360 产品名称推断原生完整球面 ERP 支持。
公开展示片段与上传时长限制不代表完整数据集的序列时长。

summary.en: Controlled synthetic urban and room sequences compare perspective, fisheye and catadioptric optics, with calibration, camera poses and optical-ray depth for FoV-aware VO and depth research.
summary.zh: 以城市和室内合成序列对比透视、鱼眼及折反射成像，提供标定、相机位姿和射线距离深度，适合研究视场对 VO 与深度估计的影响。

en.Scenes and release scope: Blender Cycles renders two environments, Urban Canyon (a vehicle moving through a city) and Room/Indoor (a hovering or circularly moving camera in a confined room), each with three optics. The requested download page currently exposes these synthetic releases; real Flyroom and Zurich experiments in the paper are not assumed to be included.
en.Optics and representation: The paper reports nominal 90° perspective, 180° fisheye and 360° catadioptric configurations. The catadioptric view is an annular omnidirectional image with 360° azimuth, not a full-sphere 2:1 ERP panorama. The catadioptric camera faces upward toward its mirror; other synthetic camera orientations differ by scene.
en.Sampling and size: Official info archives list 2500 images/poses per Urban Canyon optic and 200 per Room optic, with image timestamps at approximately 30 Hz. Fisheye/catadioptric calibration files explicitly specify 640×480; the project holds sensor image resolution constant across optics. These are alternative rendered runs, not a synchronized physical multicamera or inertial rig.
en.Calibration: intrinsics.txt supplies a pinhole K matrix for perspective images and OCamCalib polynomial omnidirectional parameters for fisheye/catadioptric images. Backproject using that model and retain circular/annular validity masks; the supplied C++ model checks only rectangular image boundaries.
en.Pose format and association: groundtruth.txt stores image_id tx ty tz qx qy qz qw and T_world_camera, transforming camera coordinates into the world frame. Join image_id to images.txt for the timestamp in seconds; the first ground-truth column is a frame identifier, not a timestamp. These are simulator references, not estimated SLAM trajectories or motion capture.
en.Depth meaning and encoding: The optional .depth maps contain floating-point ASCII values separated by spaces, row-major and at image size. They store Euclidean distance along the optical ray, including the perspective release. With a unit bearing f, Z-depth = range × f_z; do not interpret the stored range as optical-axis Z.
en.Depth coverage check: The Room info archives enumerate 200 depth associations for each optic. Each Urban Canyon info archive lists only the first depth association despite 2500 image/pose entries. The larger depth archives are publicly reachable but were not fully downloaded in this audit; complete urban per-frame depth coverage must be checked in the chosen archive before evaluation.
en.Evaluation and splits: This is a controlled FoV/VO comparison with two scenes, not an official large-scale train/validation/test depth benchmark. No standard learning split is stated on the reviewed page or archive README. Avoid splitting corresponding optics of the same scene/trajectory across training and testing; use the appropriate camera orientation, model and valid pixel domain.
en.Access and provenance: Official image, depth, calibration/trajectory info and Blender-scene archives are linked without registration. Download endpoints responded successfully on 2026-10-19; only the six small info archives were downloaded. An IMU stream or hardware synchronization is not established by this synthetic release.

zh.场景与收录范围: Blender Cycles 渲染两个环境：Urban Canyon 模拟车辆穿行城市，Room/Indoor 模拟狭小房间中悬停或绕圆运动的相机；每个环境有三种光学配置。用户提供的下载页当前展示这些合成数据，不据论文中的实验推定真实 Flyroom 和 Zurich 序列也在此发布。
zh.光学与图像表示: 论文给出标称 90° 透视、180° 鱼眼及 360° 折反射配置。折反射图像是覆盖 360° 方位角的环形全向像面，不是覆盖完整球面的 2∶1 ERP 全景。折反射相机朝上面向镜面；其他合成相机的朝向随场景而异。
zh.采样与规模: 官方 info 小包中，Urban Canyon 每种光学配置含 2500 条图像/位姿，Room 每种含 200 条；图像时间戳间隔约为 1/30 秒。鱼眼/折反射标定文件明确写 640×480，项目固定各配置的传感器图像分辨率。这些是不同光学配置的渲染序列，不是同步的真实多相机或惯性设备。
zh.标定: intrinsics.txt 对透视图像提供针孔 K 矩阵，对鱼眼/折反射图像提供 OCamCalib 多项式全向模型参数。按对应模型反投影并保留圆形/环形有效掩码；官方 C++ 实现的可见性检查仅判断矩形边界。
zh.位姿格式与关联: groundtruth.txt 格式为 image_id tx ty tz qx qy qz qw，变换为 T_world_camera，将相机坐标变到世界坐标。通过 image_id 与 images.txt 关联获取秒制时间戳；真值首列是帧 ID，不是时间戳。这些是仿真参考，不是 SLAM 估计轨迹或动作捕捉测量。
zh.深度语义与编码: 可选 .depth 文件以空格分隔的浮点 ASCII 编码，逐行存储，尺寸与图像相同。各配置（包括透视）存储的都是沿光学射线的欧氏距离 range。对单位视线 f，Z-depth = range × f_z；不能把文件内的距离直接当光轴 Z。
zh.深度覆盖核查: Room 的 info 包为每种配置列出 200 条深度关联；Urban Canyon 虽有 2500 条图像/位姿，但各 info 包的深度关联表仅列第一帧。本次确认大深度包可公开访问，未完整下载；正式评测前须在所选数据包中核查城市序列逐帧深度是否齐全。
zh.评测与划分: 这是两个场景的受控视场/VO 对比数据，不是官方大型深度学习训练基准。已核网页及包内 README 未规定统一训练/验证/测试划分。避免将同场景、同轨迹的不同光学配置拆到训练与测试两侧，并使用对应相机朝向、模型及有效像素域。
zh.获取与来源: 官方提供无需注册的图像、深度、标定/轨迹 info 及 Blender 场景包链接，2026-10-19 检查下载端点成功。本次仅下载六个小型 info 包；该合成发布未确立 IMU 数据流或硬件同步信息。

en: The 360° catadioptric release is not classified as an ERP/full-sphere panoramic dataset in this atlas.
Depth and poses are generated by simulation; they do not measure real-scene sensor noise or generalization.
Photorealism was not the original release's main objective.
zh: 本图谱不将 360° 折反射环视数据归入 ERP/完整球面全景数据集筛选。
深度与位姿来自仿真，不能表征真实传感器噪声或真实场景泛化。
原始发布以几何条件下的 VO 对比为主，并非以完美照片真实感为目标。
